motivation: A development-only diagnostic found simple rank averaging improved conditional AP over either source alone in both studies and all3folds. Rank averaging within a test batch is not deployable, so test a tiny learned combiner with fixed training-fitted transforms.

families.stacked_contrast_no_avi: No-teacher DNA active expert plus permissibleAVIraw
families.stacked_contrast_avi_teacher: AVI-teacher DNA active expert plus permissibleAVIraw
families.conditional_avi_only: AVIraw-only conditional classifier as matched reference

fixed_estimator: Per-study training-median imputation + training-fitted normal QuantileTransformer(max256knots,subsample=None) + LogisticRegression(C1,max_iter2000,seed42), plus untransformed AVI-availability flag. No hyperparameter search.
development_evaluation: For each broad fold, fit combination on measured-active rows of the other2folds using their saved held-fold base predictions; predict every row in the target fold; report measured-active performance by study. Actual activity status is not an inference input.
important_limitation: This is development/model selection, NOT unbiased nested CV: base checkpoints used their folds for stopping, and base models supplying meta-training scores can have been fitted on current meta-validation rows. The still-unseen reserved test is necessary.
final_fit: Fit combination coefficients/transforms on all measured-active development4–22 rows using saved held-fold base predictions. Deploy with the separately refitted fixed-epoch base ensemble. This can shift score calibration; report ranking only and assess once on reserved data.
batch_independent: A new row is transformed using stored training references; other prediction rows cannot alter its score.
model_selection: Add these3finite candidates to the same existing per-study/three-fold selection table. Primary role selection still uses development performance only. Preserve all original9families and matched controls.
clinical_scope: Laboratory conditional DNA-effect ranking; not patient insomnia/frailty prediction or causal gene/risk direction.
